findings.title: Capture report and screenshot can describe different layouts
findings.observed: Unmodified renderer records 1262x904 DOM viewport and first canvas x=238, then saves 1280x1000 screenshot with first glyph at x=247. Checker fails viewport and all eight available screenshot/canvas correspondences in two fresh isolated captures.
findings.cause: Inferred report/screenshot timing race: the module posts capture immediately while CLI screenshot occurs later, without a common established viewport/layout boundary.
findings.impact: Fresh native destination evidence can fail nondeterministically even when artwork and consumer modules are unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Establish the browser viewport and stable layout explicitly before collecting report and screenshot; retain failed runs and verify new captures.
